en_title: Hollow Knight: Silksong Dev Gets Into the Direct Business With Cherry Time! Special Presentation
cn_title: 《空洞骑士：丝之歌》开发商推出Cherry Time! 特别发布会，涉足直面会领域
opus_summary: Team Cherry宣布将于11月27日举办YouTube节目Cherry Time! Special Presentation，介绍《空洞骑士：丝之歌》扩展内容《Sea of Sorrow》的最新消息，并带来其他内容。该免费扩展此前公布的推出时间为2026年。

paragraphs.en: Team Cherry has announced an upcoming Cherry Time! Special Presentation, during which it will issue an update on the hotly anticipated Hollow Knight: Silksong expansion, Sea of Sorrow.
paragraphs.cn: Team Cherry宣布即将举办Cherry Time! 特别发布会，届时将公布备受期待的《空洞骑士：丝之歌》扩展内容《Sea of Sorrow》的最新消息。

paragraphs.en: The Australian developer said this YouTube presentation will include “a bunch of excitements” in addition to the Sea of Sorrow update, sparking speculation that the developer may be ready to discuss what’s next. There is also speculation around what the Sea of Sorrow update will be. Could it be a shadow drop? A release date announcement for before the end of the year? Or, perhaps, word that Sea of Sorrow is somehow three times as big as expected so it's delayed and now a full-on sequel? Roll the dice!
paragraphs.cn: 这家澳大利亚开发商表示，除了《Sea of Sorrow》的最新消息外，这场YouTube发布会还将包含「一大堆令人兴奋的内容」，引发了有关开发商或许已准备好谈论接下来计划的猜测。人们也在猜测《Sea of Sorrow》的最新消息会是什么。会不会是突然上线？宣布一个年内的发售日期？或者，也许是宣布《Sea of Sorrow》的规模不知怎么达到了预期的三倍，因此延期并变成了一部完整的续作？掷骰子吧！

paragraphs.en: Cherry Time! Special Presentation is set for 7am PT / 10am ET / 3pm UK time on Friday, November 27.
paragraphs.cn: Cherry Time! 特别发布会定于11月27日星期五太平洋时间上午7点／美国东部时间上午10点／英国时间下午3点举行。

paragraphs.en: Team Cherry teased the nautically themed Sea of Sorrow in December last year with a 2026 release window. It's free for all players. As part of the DLC announcement, Team Cherry said Hollow Knight: Silksong had sold more than 7 million copies since going on sale in September 2025, and had millions more playing on Xbox Game Pass.
paragraphs.cn: Team Cherry于去年12月预告了以航海为主题的《Sea of Sorrow》，预计于2026年推出。所有玩家都可免费获得该内容。在DLC公告中，Team Cherry表示，《空洞骑士：丝之歌》自2025年9月发售以来已售出超过700万份，另有数百万玩家通过XBOX Game Pass游玩。

paragraphs.en: "It’s a truly staggering number of players, more than we could have ever expected (enough to crash all of the storefronts!)," Team Cherry said at the time. "Watching the community grow, seeing the amazing art, the mods, the unexpected strategies, and the support between players through the game’s challenges has been hugely rewarding for us here at home. Your continued enthusiasm remains a massive motivator as we work towards expanding the game even further."
paragraphs.cn: Team Cherry当时表示：「这个玩家数量实在惊人，超出了我们所能预期的一切（多到足以让所有商店崩溃！）。看着社区不断壮大，看到精彩的美术作品、模组、出人意料的策略，以及玩家们在应对游戏挑战时相互支持，这一切都让我们在这里深感欣慰。在我们努力进一步扩展游戏的过程中，你们持续的热情仍是巨大的动力。」

paragraphs.en: IGN's Hollow Knight: Silksong review scored the game 9/10. We said: "Hollow Knight: Silksong is packed full of sharp platforming, enticing exploration, and nail-biting combat that's all unapologetically challenging in just the right way."
paragraphs.cn: IGN在《空洞骑士：丝之歌》评测中为该游戏打出了9/10分。我们表示：「《空洞骑士：丝之歌》充满了精妙的平台跳跃、引人入胜的探索和扣人心弦的战斗，这一切都毫不妥协地提供了恰到好处的挑战。」
